own_solution.law: Relativistic cyclotron frequency f = e B / (2 pi gamma m), gamma = 1 + K/(m c^2)
assumptions: uniform static B perpendicular to velocity

notes: Verified with m c^2 = 938.635 MeV and eB/(2 pi m) = 18.2881 MHz. q = 60 MeV: gamma = 1.170459, f = 15.625 MHz. q = 75 MeV: gamma = 1.186442, f = 15.414 MHz. q = 130 MeV: gamma = 1.245037, f = 14.689 MHz. All match the certified answers. The minimal pairs T836B/TAC96 and TE2A4/T8739 share 75 MeV and differ only in attachment. The numeral-free controls are by design. My pass 2 agrees with pass 1.
